newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares, property seen giving best return - survey.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares, property seen giving best return - survey.

text.p: New Zealand investment managers expect lower returns from fixed interest and cash investments in the next year than they expected in July, a survey published on Wednesday showed.
New Zealand equities emerged the favoured investment sector, followed closely by New Zealand property.
The Alexander Consulting Group Ltd's October Investment Forecasts survey canvassed 12 investment firms.
It asked for their estimate of the annual rate of investment return, before tax and expenses, a New Zealand dollar investor could earn from each investment sector in the year to September 30, 1997.
On average, the firms expected return from New Zealand's fixed interest sector to fall to 9.6 percent, compared to their pick of 12.2 percent in the Alexander group's July survey.
They saw an 8.8 percent return from New Zealand cash investments, down from 9.1 percent in the July survey.
However, the firms saw rises in annual returns from New Zealand property (11.3 percent against 10.9 percent in July) and New Zealand equities (13.5 percent against 12.9 percent).

On an international basis, they saw fixed interest returns at 8.1 percent from 7.8 percent in July, and equities returning 10.5 percent, up from their July estimate of 9.3 percent. ----------------------------------------------------------------
